name: Braided Satin Ribbon Graduation Lei
description:
Premium Material:
  • Crafted from high-quality satin ribbons, this braided graduation lei offers a smooth, glossy finish with a soft touch.
  • The durable weave ensures it holds its shape beautifully throughout your celebration.
  • The included decorative elements, such as the flower ribbon, cap charm, and character charms help adding a premium, eye-catching detail.
  • All  character charms are embroidered.

 

Sizes & Dimensions:
  • The lei measures approximately 130 cm (51.18 inches) in length, providing a comfortable fit for most graduates.
  • The braided width is about 4.5 cm (1.77 inches), giving it a full and elegant look.
  • Character charms are designed at around 5 cm (1.97 inches) tall, making personalization clearly visible.

 

Functionality Use:
  • Designed to celebrate academic achievements, this lei is perfect for graduation ceremonies, photoshoots, and parties. 
  • The included metal pin backing allows easy attachment of charms, so you can personalize it with names, initials, or graduation year. Lightweight yet sturdy, it’s comfortable to wear all day.

 

Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
  • A meaningful keepsake for graduates of all levels: high school, college, or beyond.
  • This personalized lei makes a thoughtful gift for graduation ceremonies, milestone celebrations, or commemorative events, helping create lasting memories with a unique, custom touch.

 

Specification
  • Processing Time: 1-2 working days average after payment and information updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 7 – 15 working days average (US)

 

NOTE: When placing your order, please leave your customization characters in the Note column.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
